findings.description: Root totality requires that every mixed length be uint256-representable. For bounded lists this is stated as a premise instead of being derived from the limit. This is normatively defensible, because mix_in_length is only defined for uint256 lengths, and it is disclosed. Still, it is an extra public premise that could be discharged for Fulu limits.
findings.remediation: Optionally prove the premise for legal bounded lists whose limit is below 2^256, including every Fulu name. That would leave the explicit premise only for progressive constructs and huge limits. Otherwise, keep the current disclosure.
